import numpy as np
vals = [b.get_height() for b in ax.patches]
weeks = list(range(1, len(vals)+1))
for w_list, color, label in [([w for w in weeks if w <= 13], 'black', '1-13주 평균'), ([w for w in weeks if w >= 14], 'red', '14-26주 평균')]:
    subset_vals = [v for w, v in zip(weeks, vals) if w in w_list]
    mean_val = np.mean(subset_vals)
    ax.axhline(mean_val, color=color, linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5, label=label)
ax.legend(loc='best')
